sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Commencing survey handouts to businesses while being aware and vigilant to any response calls.
Still walking around stores handing out surveys.
Received a call from management regarding issues with the online survey papers. Heading back to headquarters.
Arrived at headquarters, standing by on level 7 for survey handouts.
Received a response call from Mobile Doctors regarding a male individual consuming illegal substances and drinking in public. On route to location.

Arrived at response location, male individual was posted outside the premises consuming illegal substances and drinking alcohol in public. Asked individual to move along, standing by until he leaves the area. (photo on file)
Stand down response call, heading back to headquarters standing by for survey handouts.
Arrived at headquarters standing by for survey handouts.
Received a response call from Cotton On regarding a female vagrant outside the premises smoking cigarettes and causing a strong odor inside. On route to location.
Standing down response call, vagrant was moved along from the area. Commencing survey handouts on Lorne St.
Received a response call from Nike Store Queen Street regarding a female vagrant stealing products from the store. Standing down from survey handouts, on route to location.
Arrived at response location, kindly asked the vagrant to leave the store and return the stolen goods. All clear, no issues. Continuing services up on Lorne for survey handouts.
Standing down patrols, received a response call from Cotton On regarding a female individual stuffing stolen goods into their bag. On route to response location.

Arrived at response location, female was still inside the premises. Approached her and asked nicely to return the goods, but she insisted she would buy the products, so we are standing by at the checkout with her until she pays.

Currently still at Cotton On waiting on the individual to pay (we recognised her recently from the Nike response call), but also received a response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a female individual inside the premises causing a disturbance; will attend after the current situation.
After several declined attempts with the female individual's card she did not pay and was asked nicely to move along outside the premises; escorting her out.
Female individual has been escorted out the premises and has left the site. Responding to the McDonald's Britomart call. (photo on file)

Arrived at response location; due to our lateness the vagrant has already left the area and is nowhere to be seen. Standing down from McDonald's Britomart and commencing survey handouts on Customs Street West.

Received a call from management regarding survey handouts printed at the office; notified to meet halfway on Queen Street. One guard continuing survey handouts in the area, the other responding to the management call.
Arrived halfway at Queen Street, survey handouts received from management. Customs Street all done, meeting 2nd guard at Gore Street.
Gore St, Customs Street, Commerce survey handouts, arriving at Fort Lane.
Whole of Fort Lane survey handouts and welfare checks all clear. Commencing survey handouts on High St.
Welfare check Shortland St, arrived bottom of High Street, commencing welfare checks and survey handouts for businesses in the area.
Bottom High Street survey handouts all clear, no issues. Arrived at Freyberg Pl, commencing survey handouts at Chancery Sq.
Welfare check Chancery Sq, Freyberg Pl survey handouts all clear, no issues. Patrolling top of High Street.
Currently still at High Street talking to businesses.
Full sweep whole of High Street, welfare check Freyberg Pl, Chancery Sq, O'Connell St and businesses open, all clear, no issues. Heading back to headquarters to commence floor checks.
Arrived at headquarters commencing floor checks.
Commencing floor checks in the building.
Welfare check Macdonalds, Avachi, Hulucat, 77 Convenience Store, Mid City, Timezone, ChaCha, Subway, The Sale Shop, all clear. Standing by in the area showing presence.
Welfare check top Queen Street and businesses, all clear. Showing presence along Darby, Elliot St.
Welfare check Darby Street and all businesses in the area, all clear.
Welfare check Elliot carpark, all clear.

Encountered a female individual shouting and screaming in the area; approached her and asked her to be respectful to the area due to public peace. Female agreed and walked away. Heading back to headquarters to charge ops phone.
Arrived at office charging ops phone and responding to any calls that occur.
Received a message from management regarding a male vagrant consuming illegal substances outside. Responding to incident after letting management into the office.
Standing down assistance for management, responding to incident with male vagrant.
When we arrived at the location the male vagrant consuming illegal substances outside was nowhere to be seen. Heading back to office to charge ops phone. (photo on file)

Welfare check Noel Leeming due to a large amount of public sleeping outside the premises; gave our security details to the guard protecting the premises in case any issues occur. Heading back to office now.
Arrived at office charging ops phone and responding to any calls that occur.
Charging ops phone, doing Auror reports before commencing patrols.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street, Avachi, 77 Convenience Store, BBQ Chicken, ChaCha, Timezone Centre, Midcity Centre, all clear. Patrolling to Darby Street.
Welfare check Darby Street and businesses open, all clear.
Welfare check Elliot carpark and businesses in the area open, all clear.
Elliot Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Victoria Street.
Welfare check Victoria Street, 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Federal Street all clear, patrolling Federal Square, all clear.
Full sweep Federal Square, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Wyndham.
Wyndham Street welfare check on businesses open, all clear, no issues. Heading back to office standing by for guard handover.
Arrived at headquarters standing by for guard handover.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to Night shift. Equipment handover: 4 x Keys, 2 x Vests, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Keytags, 1 x Phone.
